description: A Refitter client Chirograph generates: its Add<ClientName>() registration reads this section to configure the client's HttpClient.

ConnectionString.description: The client's connection string, such as Endpoint=https://rockets.example.com/;Timeout=00:00:30. It wins over the other keys. When this key is set, even to an empty value, ConnectionStrings:<ClientName> is not read.

BaseAddress.description: The absolute URI the client calls (HttpClient.BaseAddress). A Refit client has no default: give it here, or in a connection string.

Endpoint.description: An alias of BaseAddress. Set one or the other, not both.

Timeout.description: How long a request may take before it is canceled (HttpClient.Timeout), as a TimeSpan: hh:mm:ss, such as 00:00:30. HttpClient's default, 100 seconds, when not set.

DefaultRequestHeaders.description: Headers sent with every request (HttpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders): each name with its value.

Resilience.description: true adds the standard resilience handler (AddStandardResilienceHandler()) to the client. Only takes effect when the project references Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience; otherwise it is ignored.

AllowedHosts.description: More hosts than the BaseAddress host that may receive the client's credentials.

Authentication.description: How the client authenticates. None (the default): the client takes its authentication from the container.

CertificatePath.description: A client certificate for mutual TLS: a PKCS#12 (.pfx, .p12) or PEM file, presented whatever the Authentication. Not with CertificateThumbprint.

CertificatePassword.description: The password of the CertificatePath PKCS#12 file, or of its encrypted PEM key.

CertificateKeyPath.description: The PEM private key, when CertificatePath is a PEM certificate without its key.

CertificateThumbprint.description: The thumbprint of a client certificate in CertificateStore, instead of a file. Not with CertificatePath.

CertificateStore.description: The store CertificateThumbprint is in, as <location>/<name>: CurrentUser/My (the default) or LocalMachine/My, say.
